messages:
maria (SRE): FYI the shared-gpu pool in us-west-2 is hitting sustained saturation this morning, lots of p99 latency and queue growth.
jon (Infra): saw it too, autoscaler isn't kicking fast enough for some tiers. queue length ~4200, p99 generation time jumped from 180ms -> 900ms.
kevin (ML-Infra): noisy tenant list looks dominated by three tenants doing large batched reranks, and one tenant doing long-context streaming.
maria (SRE): we need a short-term backpressure plan + longer-term fairness. Can we push a soft admission control change now?
ash (sre-bot): incident created: INC-2025-1832, paging on-call.
jon (Infra): short-term idea: implement per-tenant concurrency caps + leaky bucket refill that scales down when pool_util > 85%. low-risk config change.
ash (sre-bot): @maria added priority: high
kevin (ML-Infra): agree. Also consider a weighted fair queue: reserved tenants get guaranteed slots, best-effort tenants get proportionally smaller shares when under pressure.
maria (SRE): can someone post the quick config we can flip? need exact fields for the admission controller.
ash (sre-bot): here's current admission-controller snippet from prod: ```json
{"concurrency_limit": 5000, "pool_threshold_pct": 95, "per_tenant_max": null}
```
jon (Infra): propose patch: ```yaml
admission_controller:
  pool_pressure_cutoff_pct: 85
  per_tenant:
    default_max_concurrency: 50
    weights_by_tier:
      reserved: 4
      standard: 1
      burst: 0.5
  preemption:
    enabled: true
    grace_period_ms: 1500
    eviction_policy: "soft-return-to-queue"
```
ash (sre-bot): config validation passed in staging.
ash (sre-bot): canary deploy started to us-west-2:deployment/adm-controller/v2.4.1-canary
tara (Product): quick Q — does preemption affect customer SLAs? reserved should be untouched.
kevin (ML-Infra): reserved tenants have explicit weights and will keep their calculated share; preemption targets burst tier first. we should not preempt reserved unless full cluster failure.
maria (SRE): rollout plan: 1) apply conservative per_tenant defaults (50), pool_pressure_cutoff 90% for immediate safety 2) monitor queue length and p99 for 30m 3) if stable drop cutoff to 85% and enable preemption with 1.5s grace 4) follow up with weighted refill algorithm next week.
jon (Infra): executed step 1 in canary. metrics: canary host queue -40%, p99 down from 900ms -> 260ms.
ash (sre-bot): canary metrics link: https://console.internal/redwood/metrics/adm-canary
ash (sre-bot): alerting suppressed for the canary group.
ash (sre-bot): policy change applied to 10% of nodes in us-west-2.
maria (SRE): good. we still need a mitigation for long-running streaming requests — they hog KV cache and GMem. Any fast wins?
ash (sre-bot): recent logs show streaming tenant T-493 holding model sessions >15m, >80% GPU memory.
kevin (ML-Infra): fast mitigation: enforce session TTL on best-effort tenants and enable occasional checkpointing of KV cache to reduce live memory. config: ```json
{"session_ttl_minutes": 10, "kv_checkpoint_interval_minutes": 5}
```
jon (Infra): applied session ttl for 'burst' tier. early effect: avg session length down 42%.
ash (sre-bot): dashboards updating.
tara (Product): we should notify affected customers before preemption hits — product will send a message to burst-tier users explaining temporary throttles.
maria (SRE): agreed. Tara, can you coordinate comms? Add fallback instructions (client-side retry with exponential backoff and jitter, and prefer streaming chunk sizes <= 2k tokens).
tara (Product): on it. draft message pinned in #customer-notify for review.
kevin (ML-Infra): longer-term: propose scheduler change to compute a per-tenant dynamic weight W = reserved_factor + alpha * recent_usage^{-beta}, where alpha/beta tuned via simulation; that would punish noisy bursts that persist. early sim results: fairness index improved by ~22% and cost per token fell 8%.
maria (SRE): love the sim. open a design doc and perf numbers please. We need to also add admission-controller telemetry: per-tenant dropped_count, avg_hold_time, preempted_count.
jon (Infra): I'll add metrics and an alert if any single tenant consumes >40% of pool for >10m.
ash (sre-bot): change deployed to 60% of us-west-2 nodes. monitoring window 45m.
kevin (ML-Infra): next steps: run chaos test (inject synthetic noisy tenants) to validate soft-preempt behavior before global rollout.
maria (SRE): priority list: 1) canary -> stable if no regressions 2) telemetry + alerts 3) design doc for dynamic weighting 4) chaos tests 5) global rollout.
jon (Infra): progress update in 30m.
ash (sre-bot): INC-2025-1832: mitigated to warning state.
maria (SRE): thanks everyone — this prevented a broader outage. follow-ups tracked in SRE backlog. :tada:
kevin (ML-Infra): noted, will upload sim notebooks to /shared/ml-infra/fairness/sims.
jon (Infra): and I'll open a PR with the admission-controller config and a toggled feature flag.
ash (sre-bot): thread archived in 72h unless reopened.
